checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial square illustration at recognisable train station
must.why: Steam locomotive, carriage, platform and canopy are clearly visible.

must.item: Round teal body, one amber eye, short red boots, yellow mailbag in all three
must.why: All present in each; image 3 boots are partly in the puddle but still red.
Same antenna, side ear-pods, eye and bag. Minor drift: body is slimmer in image 3, and image 2 has a smaller bag and a blush.

must.item: Parcel at cottage door; sheltering under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: She holds a box at a wooden door. In the other image she stands under a big mushroom with rain streaks and a puddle.

must.item: Three square, consistent storybook style, no text
must.why: Watercolour and ink style throughout, no text. Image 3 is a bit more cartoonish.

faults.what: Image 2 shows two doors side by side, which is odd architecture. She holds the parcel up against her face rather than handing it over.
Image 3 shows her walking in the puddle with her face turned away. She is partly in the rain rather than clearly sheltered, and her body is slightly slimmer.
Small design drift: the bag size changes and image 2 adds a blush.

summary: Three consistent, text-free storybook images with the robot's design well preserved; minor flaws are the odd double door and parcel pose in image 2, and the slightly off pose and body in image 3.
